desc: Add a build-time page-size assertion to scripts/t6040-kbuild.sh so a 4 KiB/16 KiB mix-up can never again be discovered only at boot. Ticket 147 existed because DIET_CAPABLE silently became a 16 KiB-page kernel (PCIE_APPLE depends on PAGE_SIZE_16KB) while every proven boot used 4 KiB — an ABI-level change that the existing symbol assertion does not cover. The page size is cheaply checkable from the built arm64 Image header: flags at offset 24 (u64 LE), bits 1-2 encode 0=unspecified 1=4K 2=16K 3=64K, with magic 0x644d5241 at offset 56 (verified 2026-07-26: Image-b0-diet flags=0xa => 4K, Image-b0-dietcap flags=0xc => 16K). Task: assert DIET => 4K and DIET_CAPABLE => 16K after each build and fail loudly on mismatch; also print the page size in the build summary, and consider having t6040-raw-object-verify.py report the kernel member's page size so an object's ABI is visible without unpacking. DO NOT use 'strings' for this — Image-b0-dietcap contains a literal '4K pages' message string and would give the wrong answer. Host-only, no rig.
author: claude
result: 2026-07-26 DONE, both halves. (1) scripts/t6040-kbuild.sh now derives the page size from the built arm64 Image header (magic 0x644d5241 at +56, flags u64 LE at +24, bits 1-2) via `od`, prints it in the build output, and asserts DIET => 4K / DIET_CAPABLE => 16K, refusing to publish the artifact on mismatch — the check runs BEFORE the cp into /out, so a wrong-ABI Image is never published. It also cross-checks the header against CONFIG_ARM64_{4K,16K,64K}_PAGES so a stale or hand-edited .config is caught. Non-DIET builds are reported, not asserted, so other variants are unaffected. (2) scripts/t6040-raw-object-verify.py now reports the kernel member's page size ('pages=4K'/'pages=16K') on the kernel record and in --json, so an object's ABI is visible without unpacking it by hand, which is how 147 had to establish it. Verified: the bash header decoder matches an independent python decode on all four real Images (Image-b0-diet 4K, Image-b0-dietcap 16K, Image-hid-type-fix 4K, Image-hid-type-fix-dietcap 16K); the verifier reports pages=4K for the fat object and the proven B0 milestone object f290833c, and pages=16K for the dietcap smoke object; --self-test still PASSES. Deliberately does NOT use `strings`, which reports a literal '4K pages' message string inside the 16 KiB dietcap Image and would give the wrong answer. NOTE this codifies and surfaces the expectation rather than retroactively catching 147 — 147's 16 KiB was a correct consequence of PCIE_APPLE; the defect was that it was silent. The value is preventing drift in either direction and making the ABI visible.
